title: Easy to use and dishwasher-safe
text: Easy to use and dishwasher-safe. I use my Oxo 9" whisk for many different recipes (whipping air into eggs, mixing liquid ingredients, etc.), and it always performs like a pro and goes straight into the dishwasher for easy cleanup. My only recommendation would be to invest in a silicone-coated whisk as well; this will scratch up your nonstick cookware, but it works great for mixing and other general kitchen duties.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips 9-Inch Whisk

description: Beat eggs, stir batter, whip cream and stir sauces with ease. Our Whisks feature polished stainless steel wires and teardrop-shaped handles that fit comfortably in the palm of your hand. The soft handle won't slip, even in wet hands.
